svg.title: Comparing a vague prompt with a bounded five-rule prompt
svg.desc: Side-by-side workflow diagram showing why open-ended drafting invites unsupported assumptions while bounded release-note instructions keep outputs inspectable.
svg.text: Why bounded prompts beat vague requests
Replace guesswork with explicit inputs, length constraints, and negative guards.
“Write an update email from these release notes.”
✕ Invents release dates or rollout guarantees
Goal + supplied notes + 5 checkable output rules
✓ Audience and 100-word limit declared up front
✓ Explicitly prohibits unstated dates or promises
✓ Reviewer can grade 5 criteria in 30 seconds
Original teaching diagram summarizing the five-criterion release-note exercise in this guide.
